title: Stable Identity & Cross-Link Integrity
claim_boundary: Local contract and integration evidence only; native GUI, hosted CI, hardware, signing, and public release remain unverified.

distinct_workspace_ids.mechanism: Novel and Character workspace IDs are required, non-empty, distinct, and filesystem namespaces reject unsafe identifiers.

stable_character_refs.mechanism: A persisted link carries characterWorkspaceId and characterId without duplicating Character canon.

rename_safe.mechanism: StableLoreLink keeps targetEntityId and linkId when display text is renamed.

unlink_does_not_delete_source.mechanism: Unlink deletes only the relation row; source deletion is a separate injected operation.

novel_delete_does_not_delete_character.mechanism: Novel-character links are owned by the Novel side and deleting a link does not cascade to Character source data.

character_delete_reviews_affected_novels.mechanism: Character deletion requires an explicit decision and reports sorted affected Novel workspaces first.

restore_links.mechanism: Validated Novel archive restore reconstructs links, checks workspace provenance, and supports collision policy without silent overwrite.

branch_scope.mechanism: World data records retain explicit branchId and resolution remains scoped by stable workspace-qualified identity.
